art.awards.name: awards
art.awards.description: Number of significant and clearly documented awards the artist received (enter an integer; use 0 if none; exclude medals, scholarships, or honorary mentions).

art.birth_city.name: birth_city
art.birth_city.description: city where the artist was born

art.birth_date.name: birth_date
art.birth_date.description: date in %Y/%-m/%-d format (e.g., 1839/1/9), or leave empty if not applicable

art.century.name: century
art.century.description: century when the artist was active or influential (e.g., 19th or 19th–20th; can span multiple centuries)

art.composition.name: composition
art.composition.description: the way visual elements are arranged in the image (e.g., asymmetrical with central focus, symmetrical and balanced, dynamic diagonal composition, crowded and layered, minimal with large negative space). Describe the composition style in one short free-form phrase.

art.death_city.name: death_city
art.death_city.description: city where the artist died, or leave empty if not applicable

art.death_date.name: death_date
art.death_date.description: date in %Y/%-m/%-d format (e.g., 1836/1/1), or leave empty if not applicable

art.field.name: field
art.field.description: primary artistic field, choose one or more from: [Painting, Sculpture, Printmaking, Drawing, Photography, Illustration, Collage, Textile art, Installation, Performance, Ceramics, Digital art, Architecture, Mosaic, Graphic Design, Calligraphy], seperated by `||` (e.g. Collage || Illustration || Textile art).

art.object.name: object
art.object.description: the primary visible objects or subjects depicted in the image (e.g., woman, tree, city skyline, animals, abstract shapes). List the key visual elements as nouns or short noun phrases; if there are several, separate them with `||`.

art.theme.name: theme
art.theme.description: the main idea, message, or subject matter conveyed by the image (e.g., nature, war, love, spirituality, identity, urban life, social criticism). Describe it briefly in free-form text, not limited to any fixed list.
